nodes.label: Task K1 Report — fromPart10Stream public API, three-way input normalization, buffer-fully placeholder (commits 56af271+c6c8572)
Three-way input normalization (ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array, AsyncIterable, WHATWG ReadableStream)
nodes.rationale: Buffer inputs stay re-runnable through the DicomEventStream factory; iterable/ReadableStream inputs are single-use and a second .process() returns a rejected Promise (not a synchronous throw, preserving the await-process contract). ReadableStream detection is global-typeof based so it degrades gracefully to the AsyncIterable branch in sandboxed environments; a dependency-free getReader() loop is the fallback adapter.
